svg.desc: GoodEWorkers, autonomy. Recursive partition in flat colour, after Book of 100 plates B012, B011, B019, B092. Structure: frame and composition cuts; process: recursive bisection at 0.3-0.7; mark: one rule per cut, 4 / 3.5 / 3 / 2.5 / 2 by depth, flat fills. Parameters: 8 columns and 4 rows bisected at 0.42-0.58 (depth 3 / 2), shared by every cell; the lit cell spans two columns (x 203-303) in the third row and sits a third of a row (21 units) early. Seed: rng("autonomy-5"), book-core.js.
